text:
ITEM 1 | Large loose pile of dark green leafy greens (spinach-like broad leaves mixed with small arugula-type leaves) covering the left side of a white square plate, moist with slight sheen, some stems visible, spread across roughly 35% of plate surface, about 3 cm tall in a mound | 70
ITEM 2 | Pale pinkish-orange cooked fillet with light golden-brown crusted, breaded or seasoned outer edge, flaky layered texture, slightly moist, two adjoining pieces forming an elongated shape about 12 cm long and 4 cm wide, about 2.5 cm thick, lying at the lower-left edge of the greens | 110
ITEM 3 | Cubes of roasted orange squash-like vegetable with caramelized browned edges and darker charred spots on cut faces, soft-looking, roughly 2.5 cm pieces, three to four pieces clustered at the center-right of the plate among the greens | 60
ITEM 4 | Small mound of white cooked rice with slightly glossy, separate grains and a few clumps, sitting at the upper-right of the plate, about 6 cm across and 1 cm tall | 50
ITEM 5 | Small scattering of loose green herb leaves (fresh basil or similar) with a few darker tips, scattered near the rice and the fillet, each leaf about 2 cm, very sparse | 3
